title: David and Jonathan
summary: True friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read 1 Samuel 20:12-17 and look for how this passage teaches: True friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person.

tell_it: Jonathan loved David as a friend and helped protect him. Their friendship showed loyalty and courage.
understand_it: True friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: David and Jonathan reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Friendship matters.
age_8_11_explanation: David and Jonathan shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: True friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person.
teen_explanation: David and Jonathan gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that true friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: True friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person.
Courage grows when we remember God is with His people.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when friendship is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Who was David's loyal friend?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Jonathan. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that true friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember 1 Samuel 20:17 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in David and Jonathan?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Friendship Shield
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: True friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from David and Jonathan. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
